name: OneCatalog
waMessage: Hi OneCatalog, I want a catalog for my business.
title: WhatsApp Product Catalog for Small Businesses | OneCatalog
metaDescription: Share one link instead of forwarding the same photos all day. OneCatalog builds your mobile product catalog in 48 hours. ₹3,999 for up to 50 products.

hero.headline: Send one link instead of the same photos all day
hero.subhead: Every new enquiry means forwarding the same product photos again. OneCatalog puts all your products in one catalog link that you share in a second.
hero.note: We reply within 2 hours, 9am to 9pm. We work with businesses anywhere in India.

definition.heading: What is OneCatalog?
definition.text: OneCatalog builds mobile product catalog websites for small businesses across India. You send your product photos and prices on WhatsApp. We build a catalog with its own page for every product and a WhatsApp button on each one. It costs ₹3,999 for the first year for up to 50 products.

problem.heading: Does your day look like this?
lines: A customer asks what designs you have. You forward 30 photos.
The next customer asks the same thing. You forward the same 30 photos again.
By evening you have spent hours forwarding, and still nobody has seen your full range.

steps.heading: How does it work?
steps.intro: It takes three steps, and all of them happen on WhatsApp. There is no meeting and no shop visit.

items.title: You send photos on WhatsApp
items.text: Send your product photos, names and prices. Photos taken on your phone are fine.

items.title: We build it in 48 hours
items.text: We clean up the photos, make a page for every product and set up your catalog.

items.title: You share one link
items.text: Put the link in your WhatsApp profile, your status and your greeting message. Customers see everything and tap to enquire.

samples.heading: See a sample catalog
samples.intro: These are sample catalogs we built to show how it works. Open one on your phone and tap around.

items.label: Sample furniture shop catalog
items.detail: Steel almirahs, cots and office furniture. 14 products.

items.label: Sample tiles and sanitaryware catalog
items.detail: Floor tiles, wall tiles, basins and taps. 6 products.

trades.heading: Who is OneCatalog for?
trades.intro: OneCatalog is for any business that sends product photos on WhatsApp all day. It works well for:

compare.heading: Why not just use the free WhatsApp catalog?
compare.intro: Keep your WhatsApp catalog. OneCatalog does not replace it. It does the things a WhatsApp catalog cannot do.

points.title: Google can find it
points.text: Google cannot see a WhatsApp catalog. It has no pages and no web addresses. OneCatalog gives every product its own page, so people searching for what you sell can find it.

points.title: It opens anywhere
points.text: It opens in any browser. Share it on Instagram, in an email or on a printed QR code, or open it on a computer. Customers do not need WhatsApp to see it.

points.title: Enquiries name the product
points.text: Every product has its own WhatsApp button. The message a customer sends you already names the product, so you know exactly what they want.

points.title: We keep it updated
points.text: Send new photos or price changes on WhatsApp and we update it. You never log in to anything or touch a website.

pricing.heading: What does OneCatalog cost?
pricing.lead: OneCatalog costs ₹3,999 for the first year for up to 50 products, and ₹2,999 a year after that. One extra order can pay for the whole year.

pricing.everyPlan: Every plan includes hosting, 12 update requests a year of up to 10 products each, and going live in 48 hours. Extra update batches cost ₹299 for 10 products.

items.q: I already have a WhatsApp catalog. Why should I pay for this?
items.a: Because Google and people outside WhatsApp cannot see your WhatsApp catalog. OneCatalog gives every product its own web page that opens in any browser. Keep your WhatsApp catalog too. The two work well together.

items.q: How long does it take to build my catalog?
items.a: It takes 48 hours from the day we get your photos, names and prices. If some photos are blurry, we ask you for new ones on WhatsApp.

items.q: What if I don't like my catalog?
items.a: If you do not approve your catalog, your ₹999 is fully refunded. First we fix whatever is wrong. If it still is not right, the ₹999 comes back and you owe nothing more.

items.q: Do I need a website or a domain already?
items.a: No. Plans from ₹3,999 include your own domain name, registered in your business name. The ₹1,999 Lite plan uses a link on onecatalog.in, like yourshop.onecatalog.in.

items.q: How do I add new products later?
items.a: Send the new photos and prices on WhatsApp and we add them. Every plan includes 12 update requests a year, each for up to 10 products. Extra update batches cost ₹299 for 10 products.

items.q: Will my catalog show up on Google?
items.a: Yes, your catalog is findable on Google, which a WhatsApp catalog is not. Every product has its own page with its name, price and photo, so Google can read it. We do not promise a position in search results, and nobody honest can.

items.q: What happens after the first year?
items.a: Renewal is cheaper than the first year because the setup is already done. On the ₹3,999 plan, renewal is ₹2,999 a year. If you do not renew, your catalog goes offline after a 15-day grace period. Your domain is registered in your name, so you keep it either way.

items.q: Do you work outside my city?
items.a: Yes. We work with businesses anywhere in India. Everything happens on WhatsApp, so your location does not matter.
No. You send photos and details on WhatsApp and we do the rest. At the end we do a 15-minute video or WhatsApp call to add your new link to your WhatsApp Business profile.

200 products costs ₹7,999 for the first year. Up to 50 products is ₹3,999, up to 150 is ₹5,999 and up to 300 is ₹7,999. Above 300 products we give you a quote. The price depends only on how many products you have, nothing else.

finalCta.heading: Ready to stop forwarding the same photos?
finalCta.text: Send us a message on WhatsApp and tell us what you sell. We will reply with the next steps.

footer.line: OneCatalog builds product catalogs for small businesses across India.
